Methods

Survey Methodology

Complete documentation for all PPBS survey waves, including sampling, design, and recontact protocols.

Overview

The PPBS program comprises 12 datasets collected across three US election cycles (2016, 2018, 2020). Each wave includes nationally representative cross-sections and recontact panels, enabling both cross-sectional and longitudinal analyses. All surveys were fielded by professional survey companies using quota-based sampling to achieve nationally representative samples of the US adult population.

Surveys by Sample Type

Nationally Representative (N=7,259)

  1. 2016 Pre-election sample (N=1,500)
  2. 2018 Pre-election sample (N=1,000)
  3. 2018 Post-election sample (N=2,759)
  4. 2020 Pre-election sample (N=2,000)

Confirmatory/Replication (N=11,582)

  1. 2016 Pre-election sample (N=2,119)
  2. 2016 Pre-election sample (N=420)
  3. 2018 Pre-election sample (N=2,728)
  4. 2018 Post-election sample (N=3,377)
  5. 2020 Pre-election sample (N=2,938)

Recontacts / Longitudinal Panel (N=2,215)

  1. 2016 Pre-election sample (N=814)
  2. 2018 Pre-election sample (N=609)
  3. 2018 Post-election sample (N=792)
